title: Part 6
content_zh: Stratagem 8: Openly Repair the Walkway, Secretly March to Chencang — Deceive the enemy with an obvious approach that will take a very long time, while surprising them by taking a shortcut and sneaking up on them.
content_en: Stratagem 8: Openly Repair the Walkway, Secretly March to Chencang — Deceive the enemy with an obvious approach that will take a very long time, while surprising them by taking a shortcut and sneaking up on them.
